item.title: Havana Syndrome: The Invisible Weapon That Could Already Be Among Us
item.description:
Aletheia · Mexico · translated from Spanish · video

In 2016, diplomats began to report unexplained symptoms in Cuba. Intense headache, acute buzzing, dizziness, loss of balance and even real neurological alterations. The phenomenon became known as the Havana Syndrome and quickly ceased to be an isolated case. In the following years, similar reports…

Original title: Síndrome de La Habana: El Arma Invisible Que Ya Podría Estar Entre Nosotros
